seo.title: Matchy+ FAQ | Registration, services and professionals
seo.description: Read the Matchy+ FAQ about registration, local professionals, services, profiles, Matchy Wallet, privacy and support.

hero.title: Frequently asked questions about Matchy+
hero.introduction: Looking for a professional, offering services or trying to understand Matchy+? Find clear answers about registration, local services, profiles, connections and privacy.

items.question: What is Matchy+?
items.answer: Matchy+ is a connection platform that helps individuals and businesses discover professionals, artisans, freelancers and service providers based on their needs and location. Professionals can create a profile, showcase services and increase their visibility.

items.question: Who is Matchy+ for?
items.answer: Matchy+ is for individuals looking for services, professionals offering their skills, freelancers, people looking for projects and businesses searching for service providers.

items.question: What services can I find?
items.answer: You can search for local services such as plumbing, electrical work, transport, cleaning, childcare, gardening and home repairs. Categories evolve as new professionals join.

items.question: Is Matchy+ available throughout Tunisia?
items.answer: Availability depends on registered professionals and their service areas. Select your city to discover profiles and services available near you.

items.question: How do I find a professional near me?
items.answer: Select the service you need and enter your location. Matchy+ displays profiles relevant to your need and area. Review the available information and contact the professional you choose.

items.question: How do recommendations work?
items.answer: Matchy+ uses the requested service, your location and profile information to suggest relevant profiles. Recommendations make searching easier, but you remain free to compare and choose.

items.question: How should I choose a professional?
items.answer: Review the profile, services, experience and service area. Before assigning a job, clarify your needs, request useful documents and agree on the price, timeframe and conditions.

items.question: How can I contact a professional?
items.answer: Depending on enabled preferences, you may use the platform messaging system, WhatsApp or phone. Always respect each user’s contact preferences and privacy.

items.question: Does Matchy+ set service prices?
items.answer: No. Prices and conditions are agreed directly between the customer and the professional. Confirm the price, possible extra costs, payment method, timeframe and cancellation conditions before the service.

items.question: How do I offer my services?
items.answer: Create an account, choose “I offer services”, then complete your profession, experience, service area, languages, contact methods and business description.

items.question: Can I offer several services?
items.answer: Yes, within the limit of your profile or plan. Add only services you can genuinely provide so that you receive relevant requests.

items.question: How can I make my profile more attractive?
items.answer: Add a clear photo, a precise title, a practical description, your experience, service area and availability. An optional short video can also introduce your work.

items.question: Is the introduction video required?
items.answer: No. The video is optional and can be added or updated later.

items.question: Can I look for a service and offer my own services?
items.answer: Yes. The same account can be used to find a professional and showcase your own skills, depending on the options available in your profile.

items.question: Is registration free?
items.answer: Account creation and essential features may be free. Premium or visibility options may also be offered. Prices and conditions must be displayed before any purchase.

items.question: What is Matchy Wallet?
items.answer: Matchy Wallet is the Matchy+ digital wallet. It lets you use credits for selected features, such as promoting a profile or service, depending on current offers.

items.question: Are professionals verified?
items.answer: Matchy+ may request certain information when an account is created. A profile’s presence does not automatically validate every declared skill or qualification. Request the necessary information and documents before assigning a job.

items.question: Is my personal data protected?
items.answer: Matchy+ uses information needed to operate accounts, recommendations and security. Read the privacy policy to understand the data collected, how it is used, retention periods and your rights.

items.question: How do I report a profile or inappropriate behaviour?
items.answer: Use the reporting option available in the profile or conversation, or contact support with the reason and any useful information.

items.question: How do I contact support?
items.answer: Use the contact form and include the relevant account, subject, a clear description and screenshots when needed. The team will review your request as soon as possible.
